cohort: 90 pregnant women with AFIs of 5 cm or less at term (oligohydramnios group) and 100 pregnant women with AFIs greater than 9 cm (control group).
finding: Oligohydramnios is associated with an increased risk of prenatal morbidity and mortality, as well as a high rate of pregnancy complications and low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in the oligohydramnios group
